source-invariant-review.json.question: Can checked cached replies bypass an independent candidate-generation restriction?
source-invariant-review.json.finding: Cached replies originate ONLY from the checked generator visitor on the same immutable rules and same q invocation; this provenance is part of the invariant. Recheck covers kind, pattern/geometry ownership, actor base/current/owner, target/path/min-step, promotion, state/slot guards, then full S3/S4 effects/invariants. Visitor error propagates and no-reply clears the hint.
source-invariant-review.json.limitations: Source reasoning, not proof that every arbitrary raw packed action accepted by transition is enumerated on every accepted raw payload. In particular raw drop promotion encoding has a fixed255 generator convention; never generalize this to arbitrary injected/cross-rule/cache hints or a terminal certificate. No observed reachable product counterexample. Existing callbacks, Core replay and full regression are separate evidence.
source-invariant-review.json.dense_reasoning: Under nondecreasing sources, entry[source]==source and previous entry<source guarantees all earlier values<source, hence original lower-bound first match. source0 is first; duplicates/gaps/unsorted fall back. Actual naive duplicate case selects5 instead of4; guarded baseline/dense both4.
